title: EZ run
description: Makes minecraft ez to run and optimizes world generation
body:
Makes Minecraft super easy to run and serves as a solid foundation for building your own custom modpack. This pack focuses entirely on performance and optimization, ensuring smoother gameplay, faster loading times, and better stability even with large mod lists. It’s designed to give you a clean, efficient, and optimized base to build on — perfect for players who want to add their own mods without worrying about lag or crashes.

If you’re looking for a modpack that tweaks gameplay mechanics, adds new dimensions, or overhauls progression, this isn’t it. I Am’s Tweak is all about making your Minecraft experience as fast, smooth, and stable as possible — the perfect starting point for any ambitious modpack project.
